text:
I booked a case review package with this clinic for 8,900 THB, confirming beforehand that there would be no additional charges.
However, upon arrival, I was reassessed and told that my case would cost almost 20,000 THB. Furthermore, the clinic required me to change into a gown (without any clothes underneath) and fill out forms in an open area in front of the clinic, where other male clients were present.
This made me feel extremely uncomfortable and unsafe.
The staff spoke in an unfriendly and demeanor, making me feel insecure, so I decided not to proceed.
Although I didn't request a refund of my deposit, I was disappointed because the information from the admin didn't match what I received on-site.

This review shares my personal experience and I hope the clinic will improve its communication and service.

text: On February 7th, 2025, I went for a PRP treatment for hair loss. The wait was extremely long. I arrived at 4 PM and didn't finish until after 6 PM. The doctor was rude and abrupt. The blood draw was very painful and left a wound that took three days to heal. When it was time for the injection in my head, she just poked me repeatedly without asking if it hurt. Afterward, she didn't say anything or give any instructions. The assistant just patted my head and said, "That's it," and then walked me out. I just left, thinking, "One time here is enough. Don't expect a next time."
author_name: วุฒินันท์ บุญนาค

text: I booked a "buy one get one free" skin injection promotion, but when I arrived, the staff said there wasn't enough medication and only one injection was needed. I was confused, why advertise a "buy one get one free" promotion if there wasn't enough medication? The staff seemed indifferent and just wanted to get it over with. The doctor wasn't very polite either; it seemed like they were busy and in a hurry. I recommend improving the service. I only went once and won't be going back, and I won't recommend it to others. That's it.
